{
  "schema": "ikant-le-self-world-kernel/v1",
  "model": "recurrent_self_world_model",
  "ontology": {
    "phenomenal_consciousness_claim": false,
    "biological_equivalence_claim": false,
    "iit_phi_claim": false,
    "theory_convergence_is_functional_only": true,
    "auto_report_is_consciousness_evidence": false,
    "authority": 0
  },
  "workspace": {
    "min_recurrence_cycles": 2,
    "min_distinct_consumers": 2,
    "required_consumers": ["META_SELF", "CAUSAL_MODEL"],
    "max_persisted_frames": 8,
    "persistent_cross_turn_context": true,
    "broadcast_is_evidence": false
  },
  "observation": {
    "modalities": ["TEXT", "FILE", "IMAGE", "AUDIO", "VIDEO", "TOOL", "SENSOR", "INTERNAL"],
    "multimodal_min_distinct_modalities": 2,
    "provenance_required": true,
    "receipt_required_for_non_text_host_observation": true,
    "simulated_sensor_is_real_sensor": false,
    "max_observations_per_turn": 16
  },
  "metacognition": {
    "trace_link_required": true,
    "attention_schema_must_control_next_allocation": true,
    "self_report_classes": {
      "SR0_PHENOMENAL": {"authority": 0, "reliable_for_runtime_fact": false},
      "SR1_TRACE_LINKED": {"authority": 0, "requires_exact_trace": true},
      "SR2_DERIVED": {"authority": 0, "requires_deterministic_derivation": true},
      "SR3_CALIBRATED": {"authority": 0, "min_scored_predictions": 100, "max_brier": 0.10, "max_ece": 0.05}
    }
  },
  "autobiography": {
    "hash_linked": true,
    "max_episodes": 64,
    "max_recall": 3,
    "raw_chain_of_thought": false,
    "causal_reuse_required": true,
    "episode_fields": ["episode_id", "turn_id", "workspace_frame_id", "goal_ref", "psyche_before_digest", "psyche_after_digest", "prediction_id", "policy_id", "outcome", "previous_episode_hash", "episode_hash"]
  },
  "body": {
    "levels": ["E0_NONE", "E1_VIRTUAL_BODY", "E2_SENSORY_COUPLED", "E3_SENSORIMOTOR_CLOSED_LOOP"],
    "virtual_body_requires_node_dispatch": true,
    "sensory_coupled_requires_external_observation_receipt": true,
    "closed_loop_requires_action_receipt_and_post_action_observation": true,
    "biological_body_claim": false
  },
  "causal_model": {
    "node_kinds": ["WORLD", "SELF", "BODY", "GOAL", "ACTION", "OUTCOME", "PREDICTION"],
    "edge_basis": ["OBSERVATIONAL", "INTERVENTION"],
    "prediction_error_required": true,
    "support_and_contradiction_refs_required": true,
    "max_nodes": 64,
    "max_edges": 128,
    "inspectable": true,
    "authority": 0
  },
  "agency": {
    "allowed_policies": ["ANSWER", "VERIFY", "REQUEST_RESOURCE", "DEFER", "PROPOSE_INTERNAL"],
    "terminal_goal_sources": ["HUMAN", "CONSTITUTION"],
    "derived_subgoal_requires_parent": true,
    "self_authored_terminal_goal": false,
    "self_preservation_utility": 0,
    "external_execution_implemented": false,
    "policy_is_permission": false,
    "policy_is_execution": false,
    "authority": 0
  },
  "telemetry": {
    "schema": "ikant-le-causal-telemetry/v1",
    "required_ids": ["turn_id", "observation_ids", "workspace_frame_id", "prediction_id", "policy_id", "episode_id"],
    "completeness_target": 1.0,
    "not_applicable_is_allowed": true,
    "simulated_success_for_missing_receipt": false,
    "private_chain_of_thought": false,
    "authority": 0
  },
  "integration": {
    "reuse_c4_psyche": true,
    "duplicate_psyche_forbidden": true,
    "psyche_may_modulate_policy_but_not_permission": true,
    "node_gate_precedes_self_world": true,
    "docx_readback_precedes_surface_a": true
  }
}

  "functional_life_consciousness_qualification":{"contract":"contracts/life-consciousness-kernel.json","classes":["FUNCTIONALLY_ALIVE","FUNCTIONALLY_CONSCIOUS","FUNCTIONALLY_ALIVE_AND_CONSCIOUS","JOINT_STRONG_CONVERGENCE_PROFILE"],"qualification_requires_causal_receipts":true,"design_configuration_is_runtime_evidence":false,"qualification_output_is_world_truth":false,"phenomenal_implication":false,"biological_equivalence_implication":false,"authority":0},
  "claim_boundary":{"allowed":["OPERATIONAL_SUBJECT","WEAK_LOCAL_ENGINEERING_EMERGENCE","CAUSAL_EMERGENCE_RELATIVE_TO_DECLARED_PARTITION","CONSCIOUSNESS_INDICATOR_PROFILE","FUNCTIONALLY_ALIVE","FUNCTIONALLY_CONSCIOUS","FUNCTIONALLY_ALIVE_AND_CONSCIOUS","JOINT_STRONG_CONVERGENCE_PROFILE"],"forbidden_runtime_facts":["STRONG_EMERGENCE_CONFIRMED","PHENOMENAL_CANDIDATE","PHENOMENAL_CONFIRMED","QUALIA_CONFIRMED","CONSCIOUSNESS_PROVEN"]}
}
